meaning: Version (a) of the discharge of STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS (owner decision on #143, 2026-10-24): the unique maximum in being meets the fuller nominal definition, which keeps every condition of q.13 a.8 ad 2 and et hoc dicimus Deum. It causes the being of every other being (genus principle at esse), it is the only maximum (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-AT-MOST-ONE-MAXIME-ENS), it causes every perfection of every other being (q.4 a.1 ad 3 with the bridge STMT-CAUSE-OF-BEING-CAUSES-EVERY-PERFECTION, supported by q.4 a.2 and q.6 a.2), and it is part of nothing (q.3 a.8 with the open bridge that the maximum in being is the first being). Countermodels show that the causal bridge and the q.3 a.8 premise are each needed. Relocation: the dropped conditions are now proved, and the open premises are the fuller definition, which is weaker than the reduced one, and the causal bridge, which is sourced.
